To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
public expenditure and GDP growth have a negative relationship in Nigeria and a positive relationship in China.
the policy mechanisms of public spending in China and Nigeria have a positive and negative impact on agricultural sector growth respectively.
public expenditure and GDP growth have an inverse relationship in a developing country like Nigeria, but a positive relationship in a developed country like China.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between public expenditure and GDP growth in the agricultural sectors of China and Nigeria and how the Chinese experience could be replicated in Nigeria.
the relationship between public expenditure, public intervention, enterprise development and GDP growth in the agricultural sectors of Nigeria and China.
the impact of public policy mechanisms on economic growth in the agricultural sub-sector in China and Nigeria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Chinese development model of public policy mechanisms and drivers of development are more suitable for Nigeria than the present model.
the Chinese government's policy of public spending mechanisms and GDP growth in the agricultural sectors has been more effective than the Nigerian government's policy.
the Chinese government has made the right decisions to improve the agricultural sector.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
public policy mechanisms should be well designed to fit Nigeria's needs.
China's public spending mechanisms and policies are more efficient and effective in promoting economic growth in its agricultural sector than Nigeria's public spending mechanisms.
the government of Nigeria needs to restructure the public spending mechanisms in the agricultural sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
public leaders should be aware of the potential negative consequences of public policy mechanisms and should be cautious in designing them.
public spending policy mechanisms are a major driver of economic growth in the agricultural sectors of China and Nigeria.
public policy mechanisms should be designed to fit the needs of a particular economy.
